name: lamp-switch
title: Lamp Switch
description: A hanging ceramic lamp that swings on a cord and toggles with a liquid switch.
docs:
Lamp Switch — A hanging ceramic lamp that swings on a cord and toggles with a liquid switch.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Inter (300). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.
